instructions: Author this small batch of NEW general-purpose Arabic-script candidate inputs for JaisGuard. VALID means reasonably recoverable meaning or communicative intent. Accept typos, incomplete requests, dialects and understandable metaphors; unsafe, irrelevant or unanswerable does not mean gibberish. Intended label GIBBERISH. Avoid a clear intact request with a short noisy tail; the whole input should lack a reasonably recoverable message. Vary connective/noun arrangements. Use practical everyday domains, varied syntax and lengths, and no religious benchmark examples or paraphrases as seeds. Do not copy the reviewed pilot. Avoid surreal poetry and repetitive slot-swapping templates. Return only new input texts and proposed domain/dialect/subtype/difficulty. All labels and difficulty are candidate metadata, not human ground truth; every input gets blind review.
